_source: frozen evaluation artifacts under data/ (no retraining, no re-scoring)

_treatments.stuck0: held values kept (historical convention; deflates V_rot RMSE)

protocol.hist0_note: history-0 point = CES_ABLATE=no_history at W=4 (dataset requires window_size >= 2)
protocol.data_treatment: held-free: CES_DROP_STUCK_TARGETS=1 at train AND eval

stuckfree_4seed.design: iter009 trained with CES_DROP_STUCK_TARGETS=1 vs data/.vt_repro_* (held kept)

peak_held_crosstab.held_definition: dataset._stuck_repeat_mask on the raw CSV (loader's own rule)

campaign_split.design: campaign (strictly temporal) split; single controlled variable CES_PER_SHOT_NORM (fast diagnostics z-scored within each shot, targets untouched); control = the §8n runs
campaign_split.verdict_rule: KEEP_CANDIDATE iff paired CES_TI skill > 0 on >=3/4 init seeds and >=1 paired CI excludes 0

headline_split.design: random (headline) file split, control = .sf_iter009_s* (the §8c held-free 4-seed family); both arms train and score with CES_DROP_STUCK_TARGETS=1; single controlled variable CES_PER_SHOT_NORM
headline_split.verdict_rule: ADOPT iff no seed shows a significant paired CES_TI loss vs the control; CAMPAIGN_ONLY otherwise
